cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Failure Reveals the Mission
cards.instruction: Use each failed step to reveal a different goal the plan was secretly pursuing, then act immediately on that new mission.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Base can't hear our ship's report. We were secretly sent to receive. I'm switching channels.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only static. I need a forecast before my watch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. That's applause. Our real mission is entertaining base. I'm singing the forecast.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now they've switched off. You've lost our audience.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then this was rejection training. I'm handing you the microphone; refuse me a second verse.
